<!DOCTYPE html>
<html><head>
  <script src="../vendor/qrcode.min.js"></script>
  <script src="../js/pix.js"></script>
</head>
<body>
  <div id="qr" title="00020126330014br.gov.bcb.pix0111119999988885204000053039865406150.505802BR5910MERCADINHO6009SAO PAULO62110507F0000016304BF5F"><canvas width="190" height="190" style="display: none;"></canvas><img src="data:image/png;base64," style="display: block;"></div>
  <div id="output">Payload: 00020126330014br.gov.bcb.pix0111119999988885204000053039865406150.505802BR5910MERCADINHO6009SAO PAULO62110507F0000016304BF5F (Length: 124)<br>QRCode rendered successfully. Children count: 2</div>
  <script>
    try {
      const payload = window.PixService.generatePayload({
        pixKey: '11999998888',
        merchantName: 'MERCADINHO',
        merchantCity: 'SAO PAULO',
        amount: 150.50,
        txid: 'F000001'
      });
      document.getElementById('output').innerText = 'Payload: ' + payload + ' (Length: ' + payload.length + ')';
      
      const container = document.getElementById('qr');
      window.PixService.renderQRCode(container, payload, 190);
      document.getElementById('output').innerText += '\nQRCode rendered successfully. Children count: ' + container.children.length;
    } catch (e) {
      document.getElementById('output').innerText += '\nERROR: ' + e.message + '\n' + e.stack;
    }
  </script>


</body></html>
